data.narrative:
Rhoman Aerospace is a Seed-stage defense and security company founded by Thomas Youmans and Thomas Callen. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 10 private firms and 2 public companies operating in the Defense & Security sector, including peers such as UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-Progression analysis uses a $250M total raised proxy as the base value and applies a 2.5x Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier, yielding $625M. Peer-Median analysis anchors to a median valuation of $400M across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (UFORCE at $1.0B, Singularity at $400M, and NODA AI at $125M), with a stated range of $125M to $1.0B.

The two methods produce a triangulated valuation range of $340M (low) to $719M (high), with a median of $512M. The gap between methods reflects differences in capital intensity assumptions inherent to stage progression versus current market multiples embedded in peer valuations. Key uncertainties include the robustness of the $250M raised proxy, concentration risk in the three-firm peer set, and stage-specific comparability given nascent fundraising activity in frontier defense tech.
